title: Us vs Them

script.script: This is Botox in a bottle but I need to warn you about the side effects before you try it.

Side effect number one.

You are going to have to stop wearing your hair down.

Not because it looks bad.

Because people are going to keep asking what you did to your face.

And you're going to get tired of explaining that it's just castor oil.

So if you're not ready to be interrogated at brunch, please do not try this.

Number two.

Your friends are going to accuse you of getting Botox.

And you're going to keep telling them you didn't do anything.

You just roll this on at night.

But nobody is going to believe you.

Like nobody.

They're going to think you are a liar.

So if you still wanna keep your besties, once again do not buy this.

Because you will not know how to defend yourself.

Number three.

You're going to start taking more selfies.

Like way more.

Because when you finally stop hating what you see in the mirror it shows.

You're going to catch yourself checking your reflection in store windows.

In your phone screen when it goes dark.

In the microwave door.

And some people around you aren't going to be ready for that version of you.

Now the reason this even happens.

It's because of the ricinoleic acid.

Castor oil is 90% ricinoleic acid.

It penetrates deep into the skin where the collagen breakdown is happening.

Stimulates blood flow to the area which triggers your skin to produce more collagen naturally.

Calms the inflammation that causes lines to set in.

And hydrates from the inside out instead of just sitting on top like most creams.

That's why castor oil has been used for centuries as nature's Botox.

But here's the thing.

Rubbing it on with your fingers gets messy.

You waste half of it.

It drips everywhere.

And you never get the right amount in the right spot.

That's why Haven & Spool made the castor oil roll on.

Cold pressed.

90% ricinoleic acid.

Hexane free.

USDA organic.

The roller ball presses the oil directly into your skin.

Right into the forehead lines.

The crow's feet.

The smile lines.

No mess.

No waste.

No guessing.

Takes five seconds before bed.

So those are the side effects.

If you're okay with all of that you can try it risk free for 60 days through the link below.

But if you're not ready for all that maybe wait.

It's just not for you yet.
